lernapps.github.io.message:
feat: English translation of the home page and the shared site frame

## Intent

Every site of lernapps.net should be available in English as well as German, with the shared navigation included.

## Key changes

- The shared frame is bilingual: navigation and footer in German and English, a language switch, and hreflang links. The frame's checker knows both languages.
- The home page has an English version at /en/, with English texts kept in their own data file beside the German one.
- The privacy notice and imprint at /en/privacy/ and /en/imprint/ put the reader's language first; the German text stays binding.
- The 404 page shows German and English together.

## Dependencies and side effects

- apps and docs get the bilingual frame only after their pin of @lernapps/site moves (i006).
- The apps and docs translations are in the same intent (3359a71, 1d99c49).

docs.message:
feat: English docs index

## Intent

The docs should be reachable in English as well as German.

## Key changes

- An English docs index at /docs/en/, built along with the German one.
- The 404 page gets an English line.
- Documents already written in English keep their text.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs the bilingual frame of lernapps.github.io (f1b9159, same intent) to link both languages.

apps.message:
feat: English translation of the app overview

## Intent

The app catalog should be usable in English as well as German.

## Key changes

- English pages under /apps/en/: the overview, the build and enter pages, and every app's page.
- The texts of a catalog entry may be a { de, en } map; a German-only text stays valid and is marked lang="de" on English pages.
- The existing entries are translated.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs the bilingual frame of lernapps.github.io (f1b9159, same intent).
